title: Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen

sources.title: Illithid powers
markers: Mind Flayer Parasite Specimens in the inventories

summary: Spend a specimen to unlock one Illithid Power.

fields.Use: After the Dream Guardian starts Embrace Your Potential, consume a specimen to unlock the Illithid Powers tree. Recruiting Minthara also unlocks the tree. Specimens in inventory transfer to the shared pool. Later pickups add points directly.
fields.Limitations: Specimens sent directly to a hireling stay in inventory until transferred to a tadpoled party member. The outer powers require partial transformation with the Astral-Touched Tadpole.
fields.Acquisition: The pinned Illithid Powers source lists individual specimen locations by act.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
